goal: Prove the integral Bockstein statement for S2 and S3 in every degree, fixing the coefficient and basis interpretation.
outcome: For S2 and S3 all positive even-degree cohomology is cyclic of order 2 and generated by the primary integral Bockstein of the unique odd-degree skyline class. Positive odd degrees vanish; degree zero is the unit. Extension to arbitrary n fails because Sylow 2-subgroups cease to be cyclic and the odd-kernel argument no longer applies.

approach: Abstract Bockstein splitting and preferred-basis selection
goal: Determine whether the universal coefficient sequence and Smith normal form prove the conjecture for every chosen mod-2 basis.
outcome: An explicit three-term free R-complex with preferred mod-2 basis has H in its middle degree R/2 plus R/4, but integral preferred cycles and Bocksteins of individual preferred classes generate only an index-2 subgroup. A sum of source basis classes is required for its secondary Bockstein. Thus arbitrary Smith normal form cannot solve the skyline-constrained problem.

approach: Hopf-ring Sq^1 computation and C4 restriction for S4
goal: Compute the whole first Bockstein homology and detect its secondary differential to obtain an all-degree S4 result.
outcome: Computed E2 for S4 as F2[y^2] tensor Lambda(z), detected d2(z)=y^2 on C4, and proved that primary and secondary integral Bocksteins of individual skyline classes provide a cyclic basis. Exact F2 checks through degree 80 passed. No arbitrary-n extension yet.

goal: Extend the S4 proof to larger n using odd-index Young subgroups, and identify the power-of-two obstruction.
status: extension through S7 proved; general induction blocked
outcome: Odd-index S4 x S_(n-4) restrictions and primitive gathered skyline sources give the conjectured cyclic basis for every n<=7 in every degree. Every nontrivial Young-subgroup index is even at n=8. Initial C8 detection calculations motivated the next approach.

approach: C8 Mackey detection and cancellation of the secondary transfer square
goal: Construct a genuine order-8 higher Bockstein of one skyline class in S8, and test whether this handles the first new power-of-two obstruction.
status: infinite order-8 family proved; full S8 basis unresolved
outcome: Constructed U_a=(z y^(2a)) transfer y^(2a+2). Its secondary image is a vanishing equal-column transfer square. An exact C8 Mackey calculation gives restriction s*t^(4a+3), detecting a nonzero third differential and an integral class of exact order 8 in every degree 8a+8. The initially proposed unit-tail source did not have a proven secondary cancellation and was not used.
